reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing expression-image libraries and automatically selecting and sending memes in agent conversations based on emotion, preferences, and optional model analysis.

summaries.zh: 用于管理表情包图库，并根据助手对话中的情绪、偏好和可选模型分析自动选择发送表情包。
summaries.en: Manages an expression-image library and automatically selects and sends memes in assistant conversations based on emotion, preferences, and optional model analysis.

capabilities: Reads and writes a local image library and related preferences
Uploads, browses, searches, tags, and manages PNG, JPG, WebP, and GIF images
Uses configured model services for image recognition, automatic image selection, and chat-style analysis
Invokes a chat tool to select and send expression images during conversations
